alt: Course of the pudendal nerve (male) - sacral spinal nerves S2-S4 converge, the nerve leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen, hooks around the ischial spine, re-enters through the lesser sciatic foramen into the pudendal canal, and divides into the inferior anal, deep and superficial perineal (posterior scrotal) nerves and the dorsal nerve of the penis.
